titles.romaji: PriPara Movie: Mi~nna de Kagayake! Kirarin☆Star Live!
titles.native: 劇場版プリパラ　み～んなでかがやけ！キラリン☆スターライブ！

description:
Laala and friends go on a "Puchuu Tour". They visit various planets around the solar system to spread the word about how wonderful PriPara is, but challenges await on each planet.

(Source: PriPara Wiki)
